prompt: Our portfolio management team needs a consolidated snapshot of our current holdings for the end-of-day review. We have a file called `portfolio.csv` in the workspace that lists our positions — a mix of Korean domestic stocks (some identified by their Korean names, others by their market codes), US-listed equities, and an exchange rate tracker. For each position, we need live pricing data, including any off-hours or alternative trading system prices that may differ from the regular market close. We also want to know how big the gap is between the regular market price and the after-hours price for each holding. Finally, for each position that has a share quantity, include the current total market value. Please produce a single file called `portfolio_report.json` that captures all of this for every entry in our portfolio.
